about.title: Mobile-First Engineering with Strong Backend Depth.
about.copy: Over 8 years of experience in mobile application development, including 6+ years specializing in Flutter and 2 years in Android development. Strong experience with modern state management, RESTful APIs, backend development using Node.js and Nest.js, PostgreSQL, and production integrations. Experienced in leading teams, improving app performance, maintaining high crash-free rates, and delivering applications from idea to production. Blockchain and Web3 experience is an additional capability rather than the primary focus.

capabilities: Building cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter for Android, iOS, web, macOS, and tablets.
Designing scalable mobile architecture with feature-based organization, clean separation of concerns, and practical state management.
Developing and integrating backend APIs with Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL.
Integrating authentication, payments, maps, push notifications, real-time features, analytics, and third-party APIs.
Optimizing app performance through lazy loading, pagination, caching, responsive UI, error handling, and reducing APK sizes by up to 70%.
Working across the full delivery cycle including requirements, implementation, testing, debugging, CI/CD, store releases, and post-release support.
Supporting Web3 and blockchain integrations when required, including wallets, ERC20 tokens, and NFT-related functionality.
priorities: Delivering robust, scalable mobile solutions with exceptional crash-free rates and security standards.
Leading teams to successful project completion within proposed timelines and budgets.
Mentoring junior developers and fostering continuous learning cultures within engineering teams.
